bullets.text: PSTN Switchoff Milestone Achieved – Openreach closes its first exchange, marking a shift to digital full fibre across the UK.
Motorway 5G Upgrades – **VMO2** enhances 4G and 5G coverage on over 600 miles of UK motorways.
Nokia's Strategic Shift – Job cuts in Europe contrast with a $4 billion investment in US R&D and manufacturing.
AI in Broadband Networks – The **Broadband Forum** launches initiative to integrate AI for improved service delivery.
Telefónica Job Cuts – The company considers axing up to 5,000 jobs in Spain as part of efficiency measures.
World Communication Awards 2025 – The shortlist highlights leading innovators in the telecom industry.
Direct-to-Cell Satellite Connectivity – **Proximus Global** partners with **Starlink** to enhance mobile connectivity in Europe.
5G Infrastructure Expansion – **Telefónica Germany** extends its RAN deal with **Nokia** to boost 5G rollout.
